capabilities: Generate an outline note for the opened note and its children
Build the hierarchy from the parent property in frontmatter
Run outline creation from the command palette
disambiguation: Not an editor for indented bullet lists; it generates a static outline note from parent links between notes.
extras: The README states the plugin assumes the Zettelkasten structure is defined by a single parent link in each note's frontmatter; notes not using this structure may not work as expected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a hierarchy of notes linked through a parent property into a single outline note.
summary: Generates a new note containing a list outline of the opened note and its children, based on the parent link in each note's frontmatter.
